rationale: Extend the existing reasoning engine contract so deterministic rule rejections preserve a typed cause across RuleExecution and RequirementReasoningResult. This is required for downstream customer communication to distinguish missing customer context from source/convention gaps without parsing free-text rejection messages.
supersession_impact: No reasoning rule outcome, evidence selection, finding semantics, timeline algorithm, or fail-closed decision is replaced. Existing rejection_reason text remains preserved for audit/backward compatibility. The engine stops inferring missing context from rejection-message text and instead uses the typed rejection kind.
authority_impact: No new insurance conclusion, claim approval/payment authority, or product-specific behavior is introduced. Exact-boundary waiting-period reasoning remains fail-closed; the change only preserves why a rule could not safely conclude.
